# Overview

Your all-in-one guide to understanding, configuring, and using the MrScraper platform, from your first scrape to AI agents, integrations, and APIs.

![Hello](https://docs.mrscraper.com/_next/image?url=%2F_next%2Fstatic%2Fmedia%2Fbanner.78abe79c.gif&w=3840&q=75)

Discover how our powerful scraping platform can transform the way you extract data. Whether you're scraping e-commerce product data, collecting job listings, gathering customer reviews for sentiment analysis, or extracting any website content, our AI scrapers and workflows are designed to automate and simplify the process, giving you a powerful edge in any project.

## Start Here

New to MrScraper? These pages get you from sign-up to your first scraped dataset.

[### Quickstart](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/getting-started/quickstart)[### Web Search](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/getting-started/web-search)[### Scraper API](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/getting-started/scraper-api)[### Token Plan](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/getting-started/api-token)[### CLI](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/getting-started/cli)[### MCP Server](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/getting-started/mcp-server)[### Billing](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/getting-started/billing)

## Features

Explore MrScraper's key features and tools designed to make data extraction effortless.

## Use Cases

Discover how MrScraper can support different real-world scenarios.

## Integrations

Integrate MrScraper with your favorite tools to automate your data flow.

## Developer Tools

Work with MrScraper from your terminal, your codebase, or your AI agent. The [MrScraper MCP server source code](https://github.com/mrscraper-com/mrscraper-mcp) is available on GitHub for local setup, contributions, and issue reports.

[### CLI](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/getting-started/cli)[### MCP Server](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/getting-started/mcp-server)[### Python SDK](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/integrations/python)[### Node.js SDK](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/integrations/node)[### LangChain SDK](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/integrations/langchain)[### API Reference](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/api/overview)

## Residential Proxy

Route your own tools and browsers through our proxy network.
